regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Keep /kʁ/ and /gʁ/ together
lessons.objective: Hear and produce French /kʁ/ and /gʁ/ in a guided-visit exchange without inserting a vowel inside the cluster.
lessons.focus: Begin croix, crayon, and crème with /kʁ/; begin groupe, grand, and grille with /gʁ/. Keep the consonants together as you move into the following vowel and then a complete phrase.

words.fr: Le groupe attend devant la grille.
words.en: The group is waiting in front of the gate.

words.fr: Une croix est au-dessus de la porte.
words.en: A cross is above the door.

words.fr: Le guide marque le plan avec un crayon.
words.en: The guide marks the map with a pencil.

words.fr: Je prends un café avec de la crème.
words.en: I'll have a coffee with cream.

reader.fr: Un grand groupe attend devant la grille d'une église.
reader.en: A large group waits in front of a church gate.

reader.fr: Le guide montre une croix au-dessus de la porte et trace le trajet avec un crayon.
reader.en: The guide points out a cross above the door and marks the route with a pencil.

reader.fr: Après la visite, le groupe entre dans un petit café.
reader.en: After the visit, the group enters a small café.

reader.fr: Je commande un café avec de la crème avant de rentrer.
reader.en: I order a coffee with cream before heading home.

speaking.scene: Joining a guided visit at a church gate
speaking.opening: Bonjour, le groupe attend-il devant la grille ?
goals: Confirm where the large group meets.
Ask about the cross above the door.
Ask the guide to mark the route with a pencil.
speaking.closure: Merci, j'ai trouvé le groupe devant la grille.

see.prompt: Mark /kʁ/ in croix, crayon, crème and /gʁ/ in groupe, grand, grille.

recall.prompt: Recall the French sentence locating the group at the gate before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Le groupe attend devant la grille.

hear.prompt: Listen for croix or groupe in the recorded visit phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'A cross is above the door.'
type.answerRef: Une croix est au-dessus de la porte.

say.prompt: Tell the guide where the group is waiting.
say.answerRef: Le groupe attend devant la grille.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the group at the gate and the cross above the door.

lessons.title: Read clusters ending in /l/
lessons.objective: Keep French /pl/, /bl/, /fl/, /kl/, and /gl/ together while describing a classroom celebration.
lessons.focus: Compare /pl/ in place and plan, /bl/ in blanche, /fl/ in fleur, /kl/ in classe, and /gl/ in globe. Keep /l/ joined to the first consonant before continuing into the vowel.

words.fr: Le plan de la classe est sur la table.
words.en: The classroom layout is on the table.

words.fr: Une fleur blanche est près du globe.
words.en: A white flower is near the globe.

words.fr: Nous cherchons une place pour la fête.
words.en: We are looking for a place for the celebration.

words.fr: Le globe est dans la classe.
words.en: The globe is in the classroom.

reader.fr: Dans la classe, Clara prépare une petite fête avec ses amis.
reader.en: In the classroom, Clara prepares a small celebration with her friends.

reader.fr: Elle place un globe et une fleur blanche près de la fenêtre.
reader.en: She places a globe and a white flower near the window.

reader.fr: Un plan posé sur la table indique la place de chaque invité.
reader.en: A layout on the table shows each guest's place.

reader.fr: Avant l'arrivée des amis, Clara vérifie que le globe et la fleur sont bien placés.
reader.en: Before her friends arrive, Clara checks that the globe and flower are well placed.

speaking.opening: Bonjour, le plan de la classe est sur la table.
goals: Find a place for the celebration.
Describe where the white flower should go.
speaking.closure: Merci, le globe et la fleur ont leur place.

see.prompt: Find /pl/ in place and plan, /bl/ in blanche, /fl/ in fleur, /kl/ in classe, and /gl/ in globe.

recall.prompt: Recall the French sentence locating the white flower before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Une fleur blanche est près du globe.

hear.prompt: Listen for fleur or globe in the recorded classroom phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The classroom layout is on the table.'
type.answerRef: Le plan de la classe est sur la table.

say.prompt: Tell your classmate that the globe is in the classroom.
say.answerRef: Le globe est dans la classe.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences placing the white flower and globe using the classroom plan.
